okkāka: [okkā+kamu+kvi. ] (pu) CL=7 [Ukkāviyāti okkā, okkā kamati nikkhamati yatoti okkāko. Sī, bhāṭī, 3. 378. Itvāku (saṃ)] A king is named Okkāka. (When he is speaking, lights come out from his teeth as flaming torches, so he is called okkāka).
okkākakulappasuta: [okkākakula+pasuta] (ti) CL=7 One who was born in okkāka lineage.
okkākakulasambhava: [okkākakula + sambhava] (ti) CL=7 One who is in okkāka lineage.
okkākamahārāja: [okkāka+mahārāja] (pu) CL=7 A great king is named okkāka.
okkākaputta: [okkāka + putta] (pu) CL=7 A son of okkāka king.
okkākarāja: [okakāka + rāja] (pu) CL=7 okkāka king or a kind is named okkāka.
okkākarājakāla: [okkākarāja+kāla] (pu) CL=7 In the time of King okkāka or A period of king okkāka.
okkākarājavaṃsa: [okkākarāja + vaṃsa] (pu) CL=7 Descendants of the king Okkāka.
okkākavaṃsa: [okkāka+vaṃsa] (pu) CL=7 Descendants of the king Okkāka.
okkāmenti: [ava+kamu+ṇe+anti] (kā, kri) CL=7 They caused to enter.
okkāmetvā: [u(ava,apa)+kamu+ṇe+tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having caused to go away.
okkāmukha: [okkā + mukha] (pu) CL=7 A king is named okkāmukha.
okkāpabhā: [okkā+pabhā] (thī) CL=7 The light of flaming torches.
okkāvaradhara: [okkāvara+dhara+a] (ti) CL=7 One who holds the great Ukkāka lineage.
okoṭimaka: [(ava+koṭi+ma-) okoṭima+ka. ] (ti) CL=7 [Avakoṭi yassāti okoṭimo. Okoṭimo eva o-koṭimako. Abhi, pu. Bhāsāṭī.] The upper part of (the body) is bent. The squat leg and a wide stomach. One who is short.
okoṭimakatara: [okoṭimaka + tara] (ti) CL=7 One who has a short height, and also has short and bent legs.
oktanthabhikkhunī: [okkanta + bhikkhunī] (thī) CL=7 Enters as a nun.
okā: [okāsa+adāna] (sa)sādāna (na) CL=7 Not allow a chance. Doesn"t allow to get (merits).
okāra: [ava+kara+ṇa] (pu)  CL=7 As a state of inferiority. An act of falling short or being inferior. Inferiority.
okāraniddhāraṇa: [okāra+niddhāraṇa]  CL=9 Sabbesañca lokiyadhammānaṃ.. Ādīnava - vuttiyā okāsaniddhāraṇena ādīnava vicayo. Netti, ṭṭha. 23.
okārantha: [okāra + anta] (ti) CL=7 The end with an 'O' letter.
okārāgama: [okāra+āgama] (pu) CL=7 Come to the letter -'O'. See below.
okāsa: [ava+kāsa+ṇa. ] (pu, na) CL=7 [Saprekana, sya, 1. 584. Ava+kasa+ṇa. Sammo, yo. Avakasanti patiṭṭhāhanti kattummāni etthāti okāso. Pudacaca. 47. Okāsa (saṃ)] (1) A cause. (2) Realm. Region. Department. (3) The place of arising. The place of subject. Okāsakāraka. (4) A chance. An opportunity. (5) Time. A period (such as the past). (6) Jhāna. (7) An offense. (A place of reproach).
[ava+kasa+tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 To pull forcibly. To draw forcibly. See - Okassa.
okāsaadāna: [okāsa+adāna] (na) CL=7 Doesn"t give an opportunity (to arise).
okāsabhava: [okāsa + bha0] (pu) CL=7 A place of being that is a realm.
okāsabheda: [okāsa + bheda] (pu) CL=7 The variety of places or departments.
okāsabhūta: [okāsa + bhūta] (ti) CL=7 As a state of giving a chance or opportunity.
okāsaddhāna: [okāsa+addhāna] (na) CL=7 Addhāna that is the located place or realm.
okāsadvaya: [okāsa+dvaya] (na) CL=7 A group of two (Jhānokāsa, bhummokāsa) that is an open space or place.
okāsadīpaka: [okāsa+dīpaka] (ti) CL=7 Shows the realm or region.
okāsagavesaka: [okāsa + gavesaka] (ti) CL=7 One who seeks permission or opportunity.
okāsaggahaṇa: [okāsa+gahaṇa] (na) CL=7 (1) Taking the word - okāsa. (Ti) (2) Taking permission or opportunity or chance. (As a state of taking permission or a chance). (bhāvappadhāna.). Has a chance to get.
okāsakamma: [okāsa+kamma] (na) CL=7 Gives permission. A permission. A chance. (A) Asks permission. (B) Gives permission.
okāsakaraṇa: [okāsa+karaṇa] (na) CL=7 Doing permission. (Includes both asking permission and giving permission).
okāsakaraṇahetu: [okāsakaraṇa+hetu] (pu) CL=7 The sign of making permission. See - Okāsakaraṇa.
okāsakaraṇanimitta: [okāsa karaṇa + nimitta] (na) CL=7 The sign that gives permission. See - Okāsakaraṇa.
okāsakata: [okāsa+kata] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who gives permission. (2) Having an opportunity. (A) (Kamma) which has been shown the chance (a chance for giving the result). (B) The vipāka that has a chance to give the result.
okāsakatuppanna: [okāsakata + uppanna]  CL=9 (A) Uppanna, the kamma that has been granted the right (benefit); Uppanna which has been granted to yield one"s own result/vipāka. (It is the past kamma that will definitely yield result.) (B) the uppanna which has the opportunity that has been done, the uppanna which has the opportunity done by kamma.(It is the future resultant/ vipāka that will definitely arise.)
okāsakicca: [okāsa+kicca] (na) CL=7 Making permission. Asking permission. Causes to make permission. (maaū, say.)  The function for asking permission. (bhāsā, ṭī.).
okāsakāla: [okāsa+kāla] (pu) CL=7 A period of resting or relaxing. A time when (someone) gets permission to rest. An occasion of relaxation.
okāsakāraṇādhippāya: [okāsakāraṇa+adhippāya] (ti) CL=7 Desires a cause of permission.
okāsaloka: [okāsa + loka] (pu) CL=7 A world of nature or an open space.
okāsalokaparibchamana: [okāsaloka + paribbhamana] (na) CL=7 Goes around and seeks in the world of nature.
okāsalābha: [okāsa + lābha] (pu) CL=7 (1) Obtains or gets a place. (2) Gets a chance or permission.
okāsamattadīpana: [okāsamatta + dīpana] (ti) CL=7 Shows or explains merely the place.
okāsanimitta: [okāsa + nimitta] (na) CL=7 The sign that is a rising place or being placed.
okāsanisedhana: [okāsa + nisedhana] (na) CL=7 Prohibits a chance or opportunity or permission.
okāsaniyama: [okāsa + niyama] (pu) CL=7 Determines the place or a region or realm.
okāsaniyamana: [okāsa + niyamana] (na) CL=7 Determines the place or a region or realm.
okāsapariccheda: [okāsa + pariccheda] (pu) CL=7 Demarcates the place or region.
okāsaparidīpana: [okāsa + paridīpana] (thī, na) CL=7 Indicates the place or region.
okāsapariggaha: [okāsa + pariggaha] (pu)  CL=7 Taking up by the division of an arising place.
okāsaparikappa: [okāsa + parikappa] (pu) CL=7 Contemplates a space or place or realm.
okāsaparikappana: [okāsa + parikappana] (na) CL=7 Contemplates or thinking about or intention the place/realm.
okāsaparikappita: [okāsa + parikappita] (ti) CL=7 Should be intended or contemplated the place/region.
okāsaparikappāvahāra: [okāsaparikappa + avahāra] (pu) CL=7 Steals by intention the place or region.
okāsapatta: [okāsa + patta] (ti) CL=7 Reaches an occasion (of contemplation).
okāsapañcaka: [okāsa + pañcaka] (ti) CL=7 A group of five okāsa (such as the past).
okāsapaññatti: [okāsa + paññatti] (thī) CL=7 Paññatti that causes to know the variety of places or realms. Okāsapaññatti.
okāsapaṭibāhana: [okāsa + paṭibāhana] (na) CL=7 Prohibits a chance or opportunity or permission.
okāsapharaṇa: [okāsa + pharaṇa] (ti) CL=7 Takes up a wide space. (An elephant) who takes a wide space or place.
okāsapucchā: [okāsa + pucchā] (thī) CL=7 Asking for a place or region.
okāsarahita: [okāsa + rahita] (ti) CL=7 Without a chance to make merits.
okāsasabsāva: [okāsa + sabbhāva] (pu) CL=7 (1) Have the opportunity or chance or occasion. (2) Having the place or realm.
okāsasambhava: [okāsa + sambhava] (pu) CL=7 The existence of a space or place.
okāsasaṇṭhāna: [okāsa + saṇṭhāna]  CL=9 Having the form similar to the location, having the form of the location.
okāsasenāsana: [okāsa + senāsana] (na) CL=7 A place that is a monastery or dwelling place (such as near the base of a tree).
okāsattika: [okāsa+tika] (ti) CL=7 A group of three that shows a realm. Okāsattika.
okāsavidhi: [okāsa + vidhi]  CL=9 Arrangement according to the place - location. Arrangement of what is right- a right thing.
okāsavissajjana: [okāsa + vissajjana] (thī, na) CL=7 Answering (a question of) Kāla-okāsa.
okāsavāra: [okāsa + vāra] (pu) CL=7 An occasion to show the process of being the body, etc., by the power of the realm. Okāsavāra.
okāsaṭṭha: [okāsa+attha] (pu) CL=7 The meaning of permission or an opportunity or chance or occasion.
okāsaṭṭhāna: [okāsa+ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 A space that has enough space to live.
okāsehi: [ava + kāsu + ṇe + hi] (kā, kri) CL=7 May you cause to scatter. May you scatter. See - O-kāseti.
okāsesi: [ava + kāsu + ṇe + ī] (kā, kri) CL=7 He caused to scatter. He scattered around. See - Okāseti.
okāseti: [ava + kāsu + ṇe + ti] (kā, kri) CL=7 He causes to scatter. He scatters around.
okāsābhāva: [okāsa + abhāva] (pu) CL=7 As without opportunity. Without chance.
okāsādhigama: [(1) sakāsa + adhi + gamu + ṇa. (2) okāsa+adhigama] (pu) CL=7 (1) The Dhamma of gaining opportunity (2) Gets opportunity. (Gets the opportunity of the peace and tranquility of jhāna, magga, and phala). (3) The opportunity that should get (lokuttarā dhamma).
okāsādhigamanaya: [okāsādhigama + naya] (pu) CL=7 The method or way of finding the space (which is the so-called Navamakhaṇa).
okāsādisaṅgaha: [okāsādi + saṅgaha] (pu) CL=7 Taking together okāsā, etc.,
okāsākārāpanāpatti: [(okāsa+akārāpana=) okāsākārāpana + āpatti] (thī) CL=7 An offense due to not permitting a chance or opportunity.
okāsānurūpa: [okāsa + anurūpa] (ti) CL=7 Suitable for a chance.
okāsāraha: [okāsa + araha] (ti) CL=7 Worthy to be a place. Which is worthy to be a place.
okāsātikkama: [okāsa+atikkama] (pu) CL=7 Goes beyond the place that should be contemplated or intended.
okūjantha: [ava + kūja + anta] (ti) CL=7 Causes to hum (sound). (bhāsā, ṭī.). One who whistles.
okūjita: [ava + kūpha + ta] (ti)  CL=7 The melodious sound that causes to hum (sound). (say.). Whistle. Emits the melodious sound. Whistling.
okantheyyu: [ava + kati + eyyuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They should be cut off. See - Okantati. See also - Okkanteyyuṃ.
okappayi: [ava + kappa + iṃ] (kri) CL=7 Believed and had at heart. See - Okappati.
okappeyya: [ava + kappa + ṇe + eyyaṃ] (kri) CL=7 (He) should believe and bear in mind. See - Okappati.
okappeyyu: [ava + kappa + ṇe + eyyuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They should believe and bear in mind. See - Okappati.
okirisu: [ava + kira + uuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They scattered. They scattered and worshiped. See - Okirati (B).
okiru: [ava+kira+uuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They scattered. They scattered and worshiped. See - Okirati (2).
okkamisu: [ava + kamu + uṃ] (kri) CL=7 They entered. See - Okkamati 1 (A).
okkantheyyu: [ava + kati + eyyuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They should be cut off. See - Okanteyyuṃ.
okkākarājavasa: [okkākarāja + vaṃsa] (pu) CL=7 Descendants of the king Okkāka.
okkākavasa: [okkāka+vaṃsa] (pu) CL=7 Descendants of the king Okkāka.
